name: EPIC 211374104
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 11.4 solar radii and 1.43 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211374104 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM radius (solar radii) 11.409512 (16th-84th percentiles 10.967409-12.015674), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211374104 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 6054.765625 (16th-84th percentiles 5864.140625-6301.015625), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 6,055 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.43 solar masses and 11.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,743 K at its surface.
